newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Petrobras signs natgas deal with Sulgas.
newsitem.headline: Petrobras signs natgas deal with Sulgas.

text.p: Brazilian state oil giant Petrobras and state gas firm Companhia de Gas do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul (Sulgas) are signing an agreement on natural gas supply from the Bolivia-Brazil pipeline, Petrobras said.
Under the agreement, Sulgas will receive 1.2 million cubic meters per day beginning in 1999. This amount is to increase to 2 million cubic meters per day by the year 2007.

Construction of the 1,900-mile (3,000 km) Bolivia-Brazil natural gas pipeline, which links Bolivia's natural gas fields with Brazil's industrial heartland, is due to start by the end of this year or early 1997. The $1.8 billion project is due to come online late 1998.
The pipeline will run along a 94-mile (150 km) stretch in Rio Grande do Sul, and will be built at a cost of $50 million.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
